headline: The Wolf Among Us Remastered is here!
title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered Release Date October 29 | Bigby Returns | Gaming News
video_script: Bigby Wolf is back! Telltale Games' The Wolf Among Us Remastered launches on October twenty ninth, twenty twenty six, on PlayStation 5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2, Switch and PC. It includes all five episodes of the noir fairy tale mystery, with improved visuals, audio and animation, plus more than an hour of bonus content. Are you replaying it? Comment below!
description: The Wolf Among Us Remastered from Telltale Games launches October 29, 2026 on PS5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2, Switch and PC, with all five episodes and over an hour of bonus content.
